steps.label: The Macedonian vision
steps.copy: In a night vision a man of Macedonia begs Paul, “Come over to Macedonia and help us.”

steps.label: Samothrace
steps.copy: They sail straight across to Samothrace.

steps.label: Neapolis
steps.copy: The next day they reach Neapolis.

steps.label: On to Philippi
steps.copy: They go on to Philippi, a leading city of Macedonia, and stay there several days.

steps.label: Lydia believes
steps.copy: By the river, the Lord opens Lydia's heart, and she and her household are baptized.

steps.label: Trying to join
steps.copy: The disciples are afraid of him until Barnabas brings him to the apostles.

steps.label: A plot to kill
steps.copy: He debates with the Hellenists, and they try to kill him.

steps.label: Down to Caesarea
steps.copy: The brothers take him down to Caesarea.

steps.label: Home to Tarsus
steps.copy: From there they send him off to Tarsus, his home city.

steps.label: Sent to Jerusalem
steps.copy: After sharp debate over circumcision, the church sends Paul and Barnabas to the apostles and elders.

steps.label: Through Phoenicia
steps.copy: Passing through Phoenicia and Samaria, they tell of the Gentiles' conversion, bringing great joy.

steps.label: Peter speaks
steps.copy: Peter recalls how God gave the Holy Spirit to the Gentiles; James proposes a letter to the churches.

steps.label: Back with the letter
steps.copy: They carry the council's letter to Antioch, and the church rejoices at its encouragement.

set.note: This is a parable Jesus tells, set on the real road that drops from Jerusalem to Jericho. The inn is placed at the traditional Inn of the Good Samaritan site.

points.modern: Inn of the Good Samaritan (traditional site)

steps.label: Going down
steps.copy: In Jesus' story, a man going down to Jericho is attacked by robbers and left half dead.

steps.label: Passed by
steps.copy: A priest and then a Levite see him and pass by on the other side.

steps.label: The Samaritan’s mercy
steps.copy: A Samaritan has compassion, binds up his wounds and puts him on his own animal.

steps.label: Care at the inn
steps.copy: He pays the innkeeper to look after him. “Go and do likewise,” Jesus says.

set.note: John receives the revelation on Patmos. The letters are addressed in the order of a circuit through the province of Asia, which is how the trail is drawn.

steps.label: Write to the seven
steps.copy: On the island of Patmos, John is told to write what he sees and send it to the seven churches by name.

steps.label: Ephesus
steps.copy: A hardworking church that has abandoned the love it had at first.

steps.label: Smyrna
steps.copy: Be faithful even to the point of death, and receive the crown of life.

steps.label: Pergamum
steps.copy: Holding fast to his name where Satan's throne is.

steps.label: Thyatira
steps.copy: Praised for love and service, warned about tolerating Jezebel.

steps.label: Sardis
steps.copy: A reputation for being alive, yet dead: wake up.

steps.label: Philadelphia
steps.copy: An open door that no one can shut.

steps.label: Laodicea
steps.copy: Neither cold nor hot: the lukewarm church.

set.note: Matthew calls it only 'a high mountain.' Mount Hermon, near Caesarea Philippi, is one traditional candidate (Mount Tabor is another).

steps.label: Up the mountain
steps.copy: Six days later he takes Peter, James and John up a high mountain by themselves.

steps.label: Transfigured
steps.copy: His face shines like the sun and his clothes become white as light; Moses and Elijah appear with him.

steps.label: The voice from the cloud
steps.copy: A bright cloud covers them, and a voice says: listen to My beloved Son.

steps.label: Coming down
steps.copy: On the way down he tells them to tell no one until the Son of Man is raised from the dead.

steps.label: Back in Galilee
steps.copy: Gathered in Galilee, he tells them again that he will be killed and raised on the third day.

set.note: Gethsemane and Golgotha follow long tradition; the high priest's house and Pilate's headquarters are traditional sites, and both are debated.

steps.label: Going with haste
steps.copy: Mary hurries to a town in the hill country of Judah and greets Elizabeth.

steps.label: The baby leaps
steps.copy: At Mary's greeting the baby leaps in Elizabeth's womb, and Elizabeth is filled with the Holy Spirit.

steps.label: Mary's song
steps.copy: Mary praises God: “My soul magnifies the Lord.”

steps.label: Three months, then home
steps.copy: Mary stays about three months, then returns home.

points.ancient: A village between Samaria and Galilee
